To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the use of a multichannel analog to digital converter (ADC) in a readout system for a TPC is a practical solution to the problem of digitizing many channels at a low cost, low noise, low power and high speed.

the TPC readout system is capable of digitizing 20,000 analog channels in less than 40 ¿s, that this digitization rate is limited by the CCD readout time, and that the readout system has been successfully used in a TPC prototype.
In summary, our research is concerned with
developing a multichannel analog to digital converter and readout system for the Time Projection TPC.
the development of an ADC system which can digitize the signals from a large number of parallel channels.
a system for digitizing the output of 20,000 channels of a Time Projection Chamber (a particle detector) at a rate of 50 ¿s per channel.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the system has been designed to meet the TPC requirements and that the design is modular and adaptable.
the ADC system described here has been used in the TPC project to successfully digitize 20,000 analog signals in 50 ¿S and has been used to read out digital data in 50 ¿.
the ADC and readout system is working well, and that it will provide the necessary performance and flexibility for the TPC.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the TPC readout system is a very flexible, low power, low cost system which can be used for a number of applications.
a multichannel ADC system has been developed for the TPC project which has a high dynamic range and a low power dissipation, and which can be used for other experiments.

the system is a low cost, low noise, low power consumption, multichannel analog to digital converter and readout system which is well suited for applications in which a large number of analog channels are to be digitized.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the digitizing and readout requirements can be met using commercially available parts and a modest amount of custom electronics.
it is possible to build a multichannel analog to digital converter and readout system that is capable of handling the data rate required for the TPC.
it is possible to build a multichannel ADC system for a few thousand channels with a cost per channel which is a small fraction of the cost of a conventional ADC.
